changelog:
Direct Control, Everyday Reliability.

Browser edge toolbox with configurable shortcuts: URL, Web Console, User Agent, userscripts, cache cleanup. Web Console runs JavaScript on current page. Fixed sidebar handle disappearing, duplicate console crashes, HA auth URL length. Path: Settings → Web Browser → Browser Sidebar.

HTTP Page Boost: plain HTTP pages gain microphone and secure-context capabilities via local loopback. Requires Voice Channel off. Address never written to HA. Path: Settings → Web Browser → HTTP Boost.

Voice feedback and session control: wake ripple and edge glow independently toggleable. Manual session end button registers in HA Controls. Wake-word model change during active conversation safely ends Assist run first. Path: Settings → Voice Config.

Volume Follow Rules: Independent / Follow device / Follow HA, mutually exclusive. Prevents override loops. Migrated from previous sync option. Path: Settings → Interaction → Media Player. Thanks @jancernik #127 #128 #129.

VS Wake Word: post-conversation delay fixed, online profiles updated, ok_nabu/ok_stop cross-window matching added. Thanks @meiser79 #116.

Simple Clock: up to 3 HA entity states replace date row. Pixel Shift every 45s for burn-in protection. Network wallpaper cached. Background resettable. Thanks @pantherale0 #138, @odwulf #139.

Biometric Auth Mod: HA requests fingerprint/biometric verification. System prompt, success briefly turns on binary_sensor.authenticated. Android 6-8 FingerprintManager, 9+ BiometricPrompt. Never stores biometric data. Thanks @TWINKLY09 #137.

Mod Store: Catalog/Manage/Updates reorganized. Offline import from local ZIP. Chinese environments try GitHub mirrors concurrently. Thanks @deergitseason #133.

Sendspin discovery strengthened with MulticastLock, network change re-registration, outbound fallback. Thanks @Wex005 #131.

Fleet: settings navigation closer to on-device, Mod install from Fleet, compact layouts, ADB Host downloaded on demand. Gecko install detection fixed, crash recovery with backoff. Thanks @meiser79 #135. Screen-off Bluetooth fixed with directed filters. Thanks @ET1963 #122. Echo Show Support 1.1.8 with hardware-specific detection and ROM repair. Thanks @meiser79 #130. Translations corrected DE/RU/VN. Thanks @meiser79 #134.
